title: What Blood Remembers Saying
subtitle: Clinical blood study
text: The Alchemist has established the specimen. Listen now to what its former body repeated. I have recorded the Clairaudiograph and Ambergris Cylinder recipes. Place a filled creature Blood Vial and a blank cylinder into the machine, select a call, and Carve for four seconds. The blood is consumed and its empty vial remains. Preview is private; Play reaches nearby listeners. Carved cylinders retain a creature expression, not an injectable property. Identification is required for your training, but the machine can record unexamined creature blood too.
